title: 第十五章 被关着的一群小子第十六章 罕见天赋人鬼
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了
content_zh:
;;
山中除了鸟鸣，一片安静。
赢商出了门来，扫了一眼不远的雾气大阵，里面一片静悄悄，剑横秋那七个逆徒，该都在里面修炼。
十年时间未到，他也不着急去宰了那个修炼的最慢的，答应的时间给足了，但十年之期一到，就休怪他翻脸了。
走到旁边的偏殿前，喊出浪三刀来。
浪三刀修炼了这八年，仍旧是相气中期的境界，他的天份摆在那里，也强求不来。
二人心念一动，脚下云雾起来，一起朝着东边方向里飞了出去。
赢商恢复到年轻样子后，卖相极佳，颇有仙风，就是那一双深邃深沉的眼睛，有些吓人，但也因此，糅合成了他妖邪一般的独特气质，惹的浪三刀都多看了几眼，心中暗暗咋舌。
从赢商的身上，他竟然第一次看到了几分顶尖修士的风采。
要知道整个怒火道宗里，之前也只有剑横秋流露出几分。赢商现在，明显更盛。
……
东元谷中，吴山黛仿佛之前的浪三刀一样，独自一人，在亭子里修炼着，今天没有和谁讲道，而此女也依然是相气中期的境界。
“见过两位师兄，恭喜大师兄，再证磐气。”
见二人飞进谷来，吴山黛第一时间察觉，站起行礼，笑意盈盈，一副老老实实，又暗暗撩人的架势。
二人点了点头。
没有废话寒暄，赢商直接问起外门弟子的情况。
“按照你的吩咐，我已经把我记得的，囚气，磐气这两个境界里，最好的功法，挑勤奋又元气相合的弟子传下去了，修道心得，也讲了好几次，不过……大师兄，靠他们，是振兴不了宗门的。”
吴山黛飞快道来。
浪三刀也点头同意。
赢商这厮，根本不指望这些外门弟子来大兴宗门，只把他们当做自己的工具人而已，笑笑点头。

“师妹既然这么说，那就有劳你给我出个主意吧，宗门现在，该如何重兴。”
“自然是收徒弟，收好徒弟！”
吴山黛道：“小妹愿意下山去，为我宗寻找天份优秀的弟子，为师兄分忧。”
你倒是想的美！
赢商心中冷笑。
他种在吴山黛身上的，的确是自己的独门手段，但放眼沧澜星斗，他的独门手段，未必太高明到哪里，吴山黛若找人解开，便是放虎归山。
……
“虫姥姥那帮家伙，之前才打来过，恐怕还盯着我宗，此事还需考虑。”
赢商找了个理由。
吴山黛当然不指望一次就说动，深以为然的点头同意。
“跟我说说，那些叛宗而去的家伙，都投到哪里去了。”
吴山黛微微尴尬了一下，立刻点头道来。
“季黑石和他的弟子，去了万仙山脉，那里散修云集，季黑石又卷走了宗门最多的典籍，该是打算去那里开宗立派了。”
“费白鹤之前，驻守宗门的灵根园，宗门灵根属他卷走的最多，听说他去投奔了以培养灵根，炼制丹药闻名的青木宫。”
“杜哭儿师妹，一直和红楼魔宗的玉公子有勾搭，应该是去投奔他了……”
“……”
吴山黛一个个介绍下来。
这一介绍，赢商和浪三刀才发现，自己的那些师兄弟姐妹们，竟全是小能人，个个竟然都有去处，都不简单。
而转念想想，这也是他们的天道羁绊，只是这些家伙，没有仙门社稷令，无法从中获得力量而已。
“你又是如何与解战袍搭上关系的？帝师的帝望山，是我们沧澜星斗，最强大的势力之一，收徒弟从来贵精不贵多，该没有那么容易拜进去吧？”

Except for the chirping of birds, the mountains were quiet.
Ying Shang came out and glanced at the mist formation not far away. It was quiet inside. Jian Hengqiu's seven rebel disciples must have been practicing inside.
Before the ten years are up, he is not in a hurry to kill the slowest practitioner. The promised time is enough, but when the ten years are up, don't blame him for falling out.
He walked to the side hall next to him and called out "Lang Sandao".
Lang Sandao has been practicing for the past eight years, and he is still in the middle stage of Xiangqi. His talent is there, but he can't force it.
As soon as the two of them thought, the clouds and mist rose up under their feet, and they flew out together towards the east.
After Yingshang returned to his youthful appearance, he looked very good and had a fairy-like air. His deep and deep eyes were a bit scary, but because of this, they combined with his unique and evil temperament, which made Lang Sandao look at him a few more times and secretly dumbfounded in his heart.
From Ying Shang, for the first time, he saw a bit of the elegance of a top monk.
You must know that in the entire Wrath Dao Sect, only Jian Hengqiu had shown some signs of it before. Winning business is now obviously more prosperous.
…
In Dongyuan Valley, Wu Shandai was practicing alone in the pavilion just like Lang Sandao before. She didn't preach to anyone today, and this woman was still in the middle stage of Xiangqi.
"I have met two senior brothers. Congratulations, senior brother, for proving Pan Qi again."
Seeing the two people flying into the valley, Wu Shandai noticed it immediately, stood up and saluted, with a smile on her face, an attitude that was both honest and secretly sultry.
The two nodded.
Without any nonsense greetings, Ying Shang directly asked about the situation of the outer disciples.
"According to your instructions, I have passed on the best techniques that I remember in the two realms of Prison Qi and Pan Qi, and selected disciples who are diligent and have the same vitality. I have also talked about my cultivation experience several times, but... senior brother, they cannot revitalize the sect."
Wu Shandai came quickly.
Langsandao also nodded in agreement.
Ying Shang didn't expect these outer disciples to come to the sect at all. He only regarded them as his tools and nodded with a smile.
"Since Junior Sister said so, please give me some advice on how to revive the sect now."
"Of course you have to accept a disciple, and accept a good disciple!"
Wu Shandai said: "My little sister is willing to go down the mountain to find talented disciples for our sect and share the worries of our senior brothers."
You think so!
Yingshang sneered in his heart.
What he planted on Wu Shandai was indeed his own unique method, but looking at the stars in Canglan, his unique method may not be too clever. If Wu Shandai finds someone to solve it, he will let the tiger go back to the mountain.
…
"Grandma Chong and those guys just called us before. I'm afraid they are still keeping an eye on our sect. This matter still needs to be considered."
Yingshang found a reason.
Of course Wu Shandai didn't expect to be convinced at once, and nodded in agreement.
"Tell me where those guys who rebelled against the clan went."
Wu Shandai felt slightly embarrassed and immediately nodded.
"Ji Heishi and his disciples went to the Ten Thousand Immortals Mountains, where scattered cultivators gathered. Ji Heishi took away the sect's most ancient books. He is planning to go there to establish a sect."
"Before Fei Baihe, he was stationed in the sect's spiritual root garden. He had the most spiritual roots of the sect taken away. I heard that he went to Qingmu Palace, which is famous for cultivating spiritual roots and refining elixirs."
"Junior sister Du Kuier has been hooking up with Mr. Yu from the Red Mansion Demon Sect. She should have gone to join him..."
"..."
Wu Shandai introduced them one by one.
After this introduction, Ying Shang and Lang Sandao discovered that all of their fellow apprentices, brothers and sisters were all talented people, and they all had their places to go. It was not easy.
Then I thought about it, this is also their heavenly bond, but these guys, without the Immortal Sect Order, cannot get power from it.
"How did you get involved with Jie Zhanpao? The Imperial Master's Emperor Wangshan is our Canglan Star Dou, one of the most powerful forces, it is never expensive to recruit a disciple, so it shouldn’t be that easy to get one, right? "
